description: With the offset at the cap everyone leaves: the away setback (60 F) is written WITHOUT the offset and the loop writes nothing while the house is empty. On return the plain 66 F is restored, followed by ONE fresh step (68 F).

events.note: The hallway thermostat's own sensor: satisfied, so it will not start by itself.
Day classification (cold: heat all night / hot: cool all night).
Bedtime: the sleep band is written and the sleep window (remote sensor in use) begins.
Bedroom cold while the house is empty: no offset on the setback.

assertions.reason: Leaving: the away setback is written WITHOUT the +4 F (60, not 64); while the house is empty the loop writes nothing; coming home restores the plain 66 F.
Right after the restore: ONE fresh step (68), never the old cap.

notes: Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md section 10), Issue #1194 increment (e). Tier A: the real ClimateAdvisorCoordinator + AutomationEngine under FakeHass/FakeScheduler (use_coordinator=true, so the sleep-sensor listener and the 1-minute timer are real); every assertion is track=integration for that reason and is evaluated, not skipped.

(a) Effectiveness: scratch-copy mutation run of this scenario against the production code (worktree untouched). It FAILS when M01: the whole offset deleted (the write path adds 0 and the check is a no-op); M02: the +4 F cap removed; M05: the whole gate predicate deleted (always PROCEED); M12: the away/vacation term removed from the gate. Passes unmutated.

(b) Docs <-> production alignment: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Remote-sensor outer loop on the thermostat setpoint (Issue #1194, increment a)': 'Gates' away/vacation row; docs/occupancy-dispatch-spec.md. Matches production.
(c) Occupant outcome if this regressed: An empty house must not be heated to a 64 F 'setback' because a stale offset was added to it.

verdict.summary: No offset on the away setback; a clean return.
verdict.expected_behavior: Away/vacation closes the gate; the restore writes the plain target then at most one fresh step.

name: remote_offset_1194e_away_closes_the_gate_then_returns_plain_target_plus_one_step
